verdicts.reason: The two candidates are pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same problems. The heart that frames the text was white over the photo in the original. Here it sits on a white background, so it shows only as a faint grey outline and the brand's main graphic device is lost. The heart is also clipped at the bottom edge. The photo is boxed into the left third with almost no margin. The right third of the banner is empty white space, which makes the layout lopsided. The URL sits low inside the half-visible heart and is cramped toward the bottom edge.
